purpose: Development-only pretrained BF16 observer-shift mediation audit; no candidate efficacy or novelty claim
state_construction: Use validated CR17 baseline endpoint at sigma0, mix in CPU FP32 with fresh seeded Gaussian noise: x_sigma=(1-sigma)*endpoint+sigma*noise, then cast BF16. This is an artificial renoised state, not a state recorded on a sampling trajectory.
numerical_acceptance: Require exact no-op repeated velocity and gain equality; all measured tensors finite. A non-small BF16 shift residual is a valid diagnostic outcome, not grounds to increase amplitude or rerun.
analysis: Report output norms/errors and four-arm mediation, including interaction residual; compare gain-mediated effect to observed fixed-gain BF16/architecture residual without outcome-selected cutoffs. No image quality metrics, efficacy selection, or automatic promotion.
stopping: Exactly one state for each of two existing development prompts; ten denoiser calls total. No sigma/amplitude/seed sweep and no fresh64. Evaluate this evidence before deciding on any natural-generation ablation.

cost.expected_work: Model/conditioning loading plus5same-state denoiser forwards per worker; preserve batch1 state-control semantics. No extra GPU work is runnable until causal results are assessed.

prior_art_boundary: LayerNorm shift symmetry and invariant channel statistics are established. AReA already rejects channel-mean cancellation. SEGA-specific mediated null-direction sensitivity is the narrow tested claim; fixing the observer alone is not a novelty or SOTA result.
intervention_equation: Let m_i=mean_channels(FP32(h_i)), mu=mean_spatial(m), sd=population_std_spatial(m). Let p be sin(2*pi*3*w/W)+0.3*cos(2*pi*h/H), spatially centered and normalized to unit population RMS. target_i=mu+sd*p_i. Cache h_shift=BF16(FP32(h)+(target-m)[...,None]) once; this REPLACES the observer map, preserves its original spatial DC, and is not an additive harmonic on the original map.
replay_controls: Cache one realized shifted BF16 feature tensor and replay it exactly in both shifted arms. Verify every original x_embedder output equals the captured original; cross gain tensors exactly after attention-dtype conversion. Report the transverse component of the realized BF16 feature shift.
interpretation_limits: The fixed-gain shift residual is observed BF16/architecture residual, not automatically pure rounding. One exact original-arm repeat proves repeatability of that pair only, not all interventions or general numerical stability.
